notes.title: First Week Update
notes.content:
[h2]New update online, with the followings fixes [/h2]

[list]
[*] Retreats after a multi transformation. This happened because the game was still making some checks on a now-disappeared nation. This was related to this report: "The game would not advance after turn 12 with the kingdom conversions that occur at that point. I tried escaping the game several times and reloading, but it didn't help."

[*] Fougue selection doesn't let to go to next step is now fixed.

[*] Fixed Missing multi-transformation window when the first transform didn't require to transform any units. If there weren't units to transform in the first transformation the window would never appear, leading to a freeze.

[*] Sometimes clicking on a valid region to move/retreat does nothing (created situations where the player couldn't move anywhere). Addition steps are taken to prevent this from happening.

[*] AI movements orders got calculated but never applied. This is related to this report: "When the Galicians had their movement turn on turn 6, the game froze without them moving. After reloading the game, the game did proceed."

[*] Fougue selection step now works even when all units died in the previous combat (The player wasn't able to press next step either). 

[/list]
